title: Two against one
text: You and a teammate are attacking. There's one defender between you.
tip: In a 2v1, attack the defender so they have to pick one of you.

options.text: Run at the defender, pass when they come to you
options.why: Making the defender choose leaves your teammate free. Pass the moment they commit to you.

options.text: Pass to your teammate straight away
options.why: Not bad, but the defender can just shift across. Draw them in first.
It's a long way out with a defender in the way. You have a better option.
